title: feat(spec, metadata-protocol): a seed dataset can declare dependsOn, the objects it loads after
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKnsd8ZLsq9hBbRRm5JvJb2)_

Fixes #33812

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #34277 — `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` (its relationship section and its best-practice table tell the author to order seeds parent before child in the exported array, which orders nothing; `dependsOn` is not taught)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:种子数据集新增 `dependsOn`(填对象名),加载器把它当作依赖边并入与 lookup 字段同一张依赖图;声明成环、指向本次加载未装载的对象、或指向自身时,整次加载拒绝,一行不写。
- 为什么改:加载器只认 lookup 边,一个 beforeInsert 钩子要读另一种子对象的数据集没法排到它之后(blackcat-crm 的评分在评分档之前写入,全部算成 0 分)。维护者裁定「新增 dependsOn 显式声明」。
- 风险与回滚:不写 `dependsOn` 的应用顺序逐字节不变(有对照测试钉住);拒绝只发生在写了该键的数据集上。单租户启动种子被拒时,启动横幅 `Seeds:` 行标警告、`seed-settled` 消息报 `ok: false`,不再看似干净。单独发布的种子草稿是一次独立加载,其 `dependsOn` 指向别的条目时会被拒绝,需一起发布(见 Acceptance notes)。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`(`collectDeclaredDependencies`、`findDeclaredEdgeCycles`、`orderByDeclaredEdges`、`loadDatasets` 中的拒绝分支);`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`(新键与 `defineSeed` 自依赖拒绝);`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`(启动种子把整次被拒计入 rejected)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/seed-loader-depends-on-33812.test.ts`,预期 12 个用例全绿;其中声明 dependsOn 的评分钩子看到 2 个评分档,对照组看到 0 个。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(新 spec 键需 L2 契约复审,席位已申请)。

## What changes

- **`Seed.dependsOn: string[]`** (`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`): the objects a dataset loads after, by object name, for an order no lookup field gives (most often a `beforeInsert` hook that reads another seeded object). Optional, no default; each item is held to the object machine-name pattern. `defineSeed` refuses a dataset that names its own object when it runs.
- **The seed loader** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`): each name becomes an edge in the graph the lookup fields already feed (`buildDependencyGraph` gains an optional `declared` map; the `ISeedLoaderService` contract signature is unchanged), so `topologicalSort` and `orderDatasets` put the dataset after the named object. Declarations of several datasets of one object are pooled. Objects left over after the Kahn pass (behind a lookup cycle) are appended in an order that keeps the declared edges; with none declared the append order is the old one.
- **Refusals, before any row is written.** A load whose declarations it cannot honour answers `success: false`, `results: []`, and one `errors[]` entry per refused declaration (`field: 'dependsOn'`, `sourceObject` the declaring object, `targetObject` the named one, `targetField: '(dataset)'`). Three cases: the dataset's own object; a name no dataset of the same load seeds (the message says when the named object's datasets were all scoped out by `env` or `locale`); and a declared edge that closes a cycle. The refusal is RETURNED, not thrown, so every caller reports it as a failed load; a throw would have sent the single-tenant boot seed into AppPlugin's basic-insert fallback, which writes every row in authored order.
- **The cycle rule, precisely:** a declared edge `A dependsOn B` is refused when B already depends on A through any chain of edges, lookup or declared (self-references excluded, as the sort excludes them); equivalently, the edge lies on a cycle of the combined graph. A cycle made of lookup edges alone is untouched and still loads in deferred passes.
- **A refused boot seed reads as a failed seed** (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`). The single-tenant boot seed records its outcome for the banner's `Seeds:` line and the `objectstack:seed-settled` message (`recordSeedOutcome`). A refused load writes no row and leaves every row counter at zero, so from the counters alone the source was dropped from the `Seeds:` line and the message answered `ok: true`. The boot seed now counts each error of a load refused before any dataset ran (`success: false` with no results) as a rejected row, the same failure shape the marketplace heal already records (`rejected: summary.errors`); the CLI channels then show the source with a warning and answer `ok: false`. A load that ran keeps its per-dataset counts unchanged.
- **CLI, no behaviour change:** `composeSeedSettledMessage` moves out of `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` into `packages/cli/src/utils/seed-settled-message.ts` (re-exported from `serve.ts`), so the new test reaches it without importing the serve command; `packages/cli/src/commands` holds only command modules.
- **Ledger, docs, generated artifacts:** `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json` gains a `live` `dependsOn` row (evidence anchored on the three loader symbols, the runtime proof named in its note); `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` gains a "Load Order — `dependsOn`" section and stops saying the array order is the load order, and says that the dev hot-reload seeder and a marketplace install load only part of an app's seeds and refuse the same way; the ObjectDependencyNode TSDoc names the declared edges; `check:generated --fix` regenerated the reference pages (`seed`, `seed-loader`, `package-api`, `manifest`), `authorable-surface/data.json` and `liveness/state-counts/seed.md`.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-depends-on-33812.test.ts` (12 cases): the card's shape (a rating that looks up its rule only, bands two master_detail hops below the rule, the fake engine stamping each rating with the band count it sees at insert time); the no-`dependsOn` control pinning today's exact order; pooled declarations; a dataset downstream of a lookup cycle; the four refusals (lookup-closed cycle, declared-only cycle, own object, unknown name, env-scoped-out name), a scoped-out dataset that is not judged, the lookup-only cycle control, and the dry run.
- `packages/spec/src/data/seed.test.ts` (6 cases added beside the other `SeedSchema` pins): the key parses and is kept, stays absent when omitted, refuses a non-machine name and a bare string; `defineSeed` carries it and refuses the own-object case.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-seed-refused-load-33812.test.ts` (2 cases): AppPlugin's real boot seed and SeedLoaderService over an in-memory engine double, then the `seed-summary` service as the CLI reads it, the settled message and the banner line. A load refused by `dependsOn: ['no_such_object']` writes nothing, records `rejected > 0`, answers `ok: false` and prints `⚠ Seeds: … refused_load_app`; the control, the same boot with a load that succeeds, writes 2 rows, answers `ok: true` and prints `refused_load_app 2 rows` with no warning.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/seed-depends-on-33812.dogfood.test.ts` (3 cases, ADR-0054 runtime proof): a real stack boot whose sandboxed `beforeInsert` hook counts seeded bands, read back over REST: the rating declaring `dependsOn` sees 2, the same rating without it sees 0.

<details><summary>Red first, then green (head 4575480d4e)</summary>

The three that stayed green are the controls: no-`dependsOn` order, lookup-only cycle, scoped-out dataset not judged.
- Green: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` `Test Files 345 passed | 9 skipped (354)`, `Tests 22958 passed | 45 skipped`; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` `Test Files 845 passed (845)`, `Tests 27011 passed | 1 todo`; `typecheck` exit 0.
- Dogfood: `seed-depends-on-33812.dogfood.test.ts` 3/3; with `seed-external-id-refusal`, `showcase-verify-seed`, `meta-types-create-seed` 4 files, 15/15 (at `0d4aeb9798`, before the main merge).
- Not run locally, declared to CI: spec `test:repo`; the full dogfood battery (no `!`, no narrowing arm); the `cloud-connection` suite, a caller of the loader: the contract signature it compiles against is unchanged (the `runtime` suite ran in round 2, below).

## Acceptance notes

- **Files outside the claimed surface, added in round 2 for the L2 finding:** `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` (the refused-load count), `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` and `packages/cli/src/utils/seed-settled-message.ts` (the helper move, no behaviour change), `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-seed-refused-load-33812.test.ts` (the pin and its control) and `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (its double's ledger rows). The changeset names `@objectstack/runtime` minor for the visible change and `@objectstack/cli` minor for the moved helper.
- **"Same load" is the request the loader is handed.** The boot seed and the per-organization replay load every dataset of the app (the replay, every installed package's), so a `dependsOn` across them resolves. A draft publish loads only the bodies being published, so a published seed whose `dependsOn` names an object seeded by another item is refused until both are published together; the changeset and the docs page say so. This is the ruling applied literally; whether a publish should judge against already-landed rows instead is raised as an open question in the report, not decided here.
- **A declared edge that a deferred lookup could have satisfied is still refused.** Lookup edges are deferrable (the row is written and its reference filled in later), so `A dependsOn B` while B looks up A is orderable in principle; the ruling refuses any cycle a declared edge closes, and so does this PR.
- **`errors[].recordIndex` is 0 on a refusal.** The error schema requires a non-negative row index and a refusal belongs to the dataset, not to a row; `field: 'dependsOn'` and `targetField: '(dataset)'` mark it. Widening the error shape is a contract change and not part of this card.
- **The ledger row carries no `proof` field.** The ADR-0054 `proof` form needs the dogfood file's `@proof:` tag registered in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts`, whose classes are the high-risk list of ADR-0054 §2a; seed ordering is in none of them and that file is outside this card's surface. The dogfood proof is named in the row's note.
- **The own-object guard is redundant with the cycle rule** (observed by ablation: disabling it leaves the case refused, as a one-object cycle). It stays for its clearer message and because `defineSeed` refuses the same case at call time.
- **Marketplace purge and sample-data scope** call `buildDependencyGraph(objectNames)` without declared edges, so their (reverse) order ignores `dependsOn`; that path deletes rows and the key is about insert-time reads, so nothing there is wrong today. Noted only.

## Verification

Hypotheses from the dispatch, each measured:

- H1 held: on the base loader the card shape is red (rating inserted at index 2, bands at 3; the hook saw 0 bands).
- H2 held: the declared edge joins `buildDependencyGraph`'s node `dependsOn`, `topologicalSort` orders by it, and authored order stays the Kahn tie-break.
- H3 held: lookup-only cycles still resolve by deferred passes. Rule as built: a declared edge is refused when its target already depends on its declarer through any chain of edges (it lies on a cycle of the combined graph).
- H4: refusals sit at load time, plus `defineSeed` at call time for the one case a dataset can be judged on alone (its own object). The set of objects in the same load exists only at load time: `env` and `locale` filtering, several packages in one replay, and a draft publish's one-item load all change it after authoring.
- H5: `Metadata-protocol: added` takes `minor` on every moved published package (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cli`) per AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3; the private dogfood package carries no changeset.
